page.content:
Armstrong, known as Takasu in the Japanese version and simply Chief in Stardust Accelerator, is the Chief of The Facility. He is a large, overwhelming man with a cruel personality and a particularly loud, booming voice.…

page.overview:
Who is Mr. Armstrong?

Mr. Armstrong, known as ( Takasu) in the Japanese version, is an opponent in Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist and Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist: Link Evolution. This is a video game depiction of Mr. Armstrong, a character from the Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's anime.
